First public release of Proxy Deck, a lightweight Windows tray app for CLIProxy and Codex account quotas.

### Downloads

- **ProxyDeck-Setup.exe**: Recommended Windows installer. Download and run it, then follow the setup wizard.
- **ProxyDeck-Windows-x64.zip**: The same installer with its runtime configuration, documentation, license, and startup recovery script. Extract the whole archive before running the installer. This is not a portable installation.
- **ProxyDeck-Setup.exe.config**: Runtime configuration, also included in the ZIP.
- **SHA256SUMS.txt**: SHA-256 checksums for the installer, runtime configuration, and ZIP.

### Features

- Installs missing CLIProxyAPI and Codex Fleet Manager components from verified upstream packages.
- Displays account quotas and reset times in a dark system tray panel.
- Offers optional Tailscale access and Auto Warm, both disabled by default for new users.
- Connects Codex accounts through browser sign-in.
- Starts on demand, with no automatic Windows startup.
- Provides an English setup wizard, interface, and documentation.

### Requirements and setup

Windows 10/11 x64 with .NET Framework 4.8 and internet access for initial component downloads. Tailscale installation and service setup may request administrator approval. The Proxy Deck executable is unsigned. ARM64 and 32-bit Windows are not supported.

For an existing CLIProxy setup, select its folder and provide its management key. To update Proxy Deck, select **Exit and stop system** in its tray menu before running the new installer. Settings and connected accounts are preserved.

Build verification and an isolated installation test run in GitHub Actions before publication. A fresh Tailscale MSI installation has not been validated on a clean Windows machine.
